question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**presence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the swelling of plant roots due to the accumulation of storage food.
 
• The appropriate word should indicate the presence of something that causes swelling in the roots.
 
• "**Presence**" (उपस्थिति) fits well as it denotes the state of being or existing, which makes sense for storage food in the context.
 
• Other options ("**occupancy**", "**residence**", "**existence**") do not fit the context of describing the swelling due to storage food in plant roots.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The roots of some plants get swollen with the presence__ of storage food which can be used as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are (2)____________ staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Occupancy **(निवास): "Occupancy" means the act of residing or taking up space, which does not fit the context of storage food in plant roots.
 
• **Residence **(निवास): "Residence" implies a place where one lives, unsuitable for describing storage food in plant roots.
 
• **Existence **(अस्तित्व): "Existence" means the state of being, which is relevant but not as precise as "presence" in this context.
